caseName: Rivoli Trucking Corp. v. New York Shipping Ass'n
caseNameFull: Rivoli Trucking Corp. v. New York Shipping Assn., Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 2d Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certio-rari, certiorari denied.
